_comment: Copy this file to config.local.json and fill in your UniFi console details. config.local.json is git-ignored so your password never gets committed. Every field can also be supplied via environment variables (UNIFI_HOST, UNIFI_PORT, UNIFI_HTTPS, UNIFI_USERNAME, UNIFI_PASSWORD, UNIFI_API_KEY, UNIFI_SITE, UNIFI_VERIFY_SSL, UNIFI_TIMEOUT), which override the file. Use a LOCAL admin account (Ubiquiti cloud/SSO accounts with MFA cannot log in via the API). api_key is optional and only needed for the official Integration API.
